player_prompt.intro:
Udlala {color} emdlalweni we-Breakthrough. Uya {direction} kwenye ibhodi elinawo {board_size}x{board_size}.
Kwenye ilodi yakho, unaweza kusuka ipheshe elilodwa isinye phambili noma phambili ngomgomo.
Ipheshe lingasuka ngomgomo kuphela uma ipheshe lempikisano likhona, futhi lingasuka ngaphakathi kwesikwele esinamapheshe alempikisano kuphela ngosuku olungomgomo.
Uma usuka ngaphakathi kwesikwele esinamapheshe alempikisano, uyathatha ipheshe lempikisano, lipheshe lempikisano lithathwa njalo kwenye ibhodi.
Sebenzisa ulelezi ofanana no-UCI ngaphakathi kwemabhetshana, mfano [a2a3] ukusuka a2 iye a3.
* 'a' inalingana nekolomu yesokunxele, '1' iyilayini yaphansi (ngokuya ngempela kaMhlophe).
* Ilayini yasekhaya yaMnyama iyilayini yenhla (ilayini 8 kwa ibhodi elinawo 8x8). Ilayini yasekhaya yaMhlophe iyilayini yaphansi (ilayini 1 kwa ibhodi elinawo 8x8).
Umuntu wokuqala kuphonsa ipheshe laye kwenye ilayini yasekhaya yempikisano uphumelele. Uma amapheshe akho wonke athathwa, uyahluleka.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sicela usebenzise inothi ye-algebraic enama-bracket afana ne- [a2a3].
invalid_move.illegal: Lokho kuhamba akulandeli imithetho yokuGqekeza noma akuyona into yakho.
